Data Scientist

Beta Labs is hiring a data scientist to work on forecasting and experimentation across our products and teams. You will partner with product managers and engineers to turn open-ended questions into measurable experiments, and you will present your findings to leadership every quarter. We value clear writing, curiosity, and careful statistical thinking in everyone on the team.

What you'll do

  • Build forecasting models in Python
  • Design A/B testing experiments

Requirements

  • Strong SQL and statistics
  • Experience with pandas

Benefits

Great health coverage, flexible time off, and a learning budget for every employee.
